title: ArtifactReference
description: A contribution spilled whole to the kubemoot_discussion_artifacts Object Store, carried as metadata.artifact on the signal and in the ArtifactNotice on kubemoot.artifacts.

key.description: The object key: <namespace>/<crew>/<threadId>/<agent>/<signal>-<uuid>, with nocrew for a crewless agent.

bytes.description: Size of the object in bytes.

agent.description: The agent that spilled the contribution.

tool.description: The signal the contribution was sent with, such as agree.

createdAt.description: When the object was written, RFC 3339 in UTC.
